title: Economy
description: Values used to work out prices and payments. Money is in pence.

upkeep.description: The cost of keeping the inn open, each something you can see. Wood, oil and sundries are pantry goods, used up as you go; the licence is paid weekly.

licence.description: Paid on the morning of this weekday (not the first day).

firewood.description: Logs burned per game hour: by the hearth while it's lit (times coldOrWetFactor in winter or rain), and by each wood stove while something's cooking on it. Without wood the fire goes out and wood stoves stop.

lampOil.description: Burned while the lamps are lit. Without it the lamps can't be lit, and when it's gloomy inside the room stays dark.

darkFlow.description: In the dark, passers-by come in at this share of the usual rate: the inn looks shut from the road.

darkPatience.description: In the dark, guests wait this share of their usual patience.

sundries.description: Napkins, soap, matches: used for each guest served. Without them, tips are this share of what they'd be.

price.description: Worked-out price = (ingredient cost + prep cost + perTraySlot x tray slots) x (1 + margin) x (1 + markup) x house level x staleness factor. A dish's price.fixed replaces the worked-out part.

markup.description: Fraction added to every worked-out price.

margin.description: Fraction added on top of cost.

readyMade.description: Ready-made goods (a baker's pie or bread) sell for what one serving cost, times this, times the house level and staleness. No margin or markup: there's no cooking in them.

prepPerMinute.description: Pence per minute of cooking. Split across the servings of a batch.

perTraySlot.description: Added to each serving per tray slot it takes.

roundShownTo.description: Shown prices are rounded to this many pence; the exact amount is paid.

flow.description: Multiplier on how many come in.

walkoutShare.description: Share of the tip a guest who walks out still pays.

startingPantry.description: Ingredient id: units a new keeper starts with.

deliveryFee.description: What the carter charges each morning he brings orders, however many.

sellBackShare.description: Share of the price paid back when selling equipment.

fetchMinutes.description: Game minutes away when fetching equipment yourself.
